en.title: Maximum Audience When Each Screening Ends Strictly Before the Next
en.description:
Choose some screenings, where a screening ends at start+duration. Two screenings do not conflict only if one ends strictly before the other starts; equal endpoints are not allowed. Find the maximum total audience. The source's second example confirms the strict inequality.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000), followed by three lines start, duration and volume; the first two are in 1..10⁹, and volume is in 1..1000.
en.explanation: Example 1: choose the two screenings starting at 5 and 18, 51+25=76. Example 2: the screening starting at 2 ends at 4, so it cannot be followed by the screening starting at 4; choose the ones starting at 1 and 4, for a total of 4. Example 3: the first screening ends exactly when the second starts, so only the screening with audience 7 can be chosen.
hints: Sort by end time and let dp record the best value of the first several screenings; for each screening, binary search the number of screenings that end strictly before it starts, and compare taking it with skipping it.
